dogecoin.text: Bitwise filed an S-1 registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday for a spot Aptos exchange-traded fund. Bitwise has also filed to launch Dogecoin and XRP exchange traded funds. https://t.co/OsNgWCTlAS
